cards.ex: You've got to be thick-skinned to survive in this business.
cards.exUz: Bu biznesda omon qolish uchun beparvo bo'lishing kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidga befarq, hech narsaga xafa bo'lmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: She wears her heart on her sleeve, which makes her vulnerable.
cards.exUz: U his-tuyg'ularini ochiq ko'rsatadi, bu uni zaif qiladi.

cards.ex: He was a larger than life character, full of energy and enthusiasm.
cards.exUz: U hayotiylikdan ustun, energiya va ishtiyoqqa to'la odam edi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy odamdan ko'ra qiziqarliroq va diqqatga sazovor shaxs.

cards.ex: She always gets her own way; it's exhausting dealing with her.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z bildigicha qiladi; u bilan ishlash charchatadi.
cards.uzDef: Doim o'zi xohlagan narsaga erishishga harakat qiladi.

cards.ex: Don't be such a wet blanket! Come on, let's dance!
cards.exUz: Bunday zerikarli bo'lma! Kel, raqsga tushaylik!

cards.ex: My nephew is a real bundle of energy; he never stops moving!
cards.exUz: Jiyanim haqiqiy energiya manbai; u hech qachon to'xtamaydi!
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p energiya va g'ayratga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: She's such a people pleaser; she'll agree to anything.
cards.exUz: U juda xushomadgo'y; u har qanday narsaga rozi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha odamlarga yoqishga harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: He's always the life of the party, cracking jokes and telling stories.
cards.exUz: U har doim davra sultoni, hazillar aytadi va hikoyalar so'zlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday ziyofatda yoki tadbirda eng qiziqarli odam.

cards.ex: He tried to butter me up before asking for a favor.
cards.exUz: U mendan iltimos qilishdan oldin xushomad qilishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishiga maqsadga erishish uchun xushomad qilish.

cards.ex: I'm still on the fence about accepting the new job offer.
cards.exUz: Men hali yangi ish taklifini qabul qilish haqida ikki o'yliqdaman.

cards.ex: Despite the pressure, she rose to the occasion and delivered a great presentation.
cards.exUz: Bosimga qaramay, u vaziyatga moslashdi va ajoyib taqdimot qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yaxshi ishlashga qodir bo'lish.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop panicking.
cards.exUz: O'zingni tutishing va vahima qilishni to'xtatishing kerak.

cards.ex: I don't want to rock the boat, but I think we should reconsider this decision.
cards.exUz: Men muammo yaratmoqchi emasman, lekin bu qarorni qayta ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak deb o'ylayman.

cards.ex: You need to have a backbone and stand up for what you believe in.
cards.exUz: Siz qatiyatli bo'lishingiz va o'zingiz ishongan narsalar uchun kurashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrida qat'iy turish, jasoratli bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm a bit of a people watcher; I find it fascinating to observe human behavior.
cards.exUz: Men odamlarni kuzatishni yaxshi ko'raman; inson xatti-harakatlarini kuzatish menga juda qiziq.

cards.ex: I usually just go with the flow and see what happens.
cards.exUz: Men odatda oqim bo'ylab suzaman va nima bo'lishini ko'raman.

cards.ex: Our new assistant is really on the ball; she gets everything done quickly and efficiently.
cards.exUz: Yangi yordamchimiz juda harakatchan; u hamma narsani tez va samarali bajaradi.

cards.ex: He's pushing his luck by driving so fast in this weather.
cards.exUz: U bu ob-havoda juda tez haydab, omadini sinamoqda.

cards.ex: As a leader, you need to set an example for your team.
cards.exUz: Rahbar sifatida siz jamoangizga namuna bo'lishingiz kerak.

cards.ex: He comes across as a bit arrogant, but he's actually very kind.
cards.exUz: U biroz takabbur ko'rinadi, lekin aslida juda mehribon.

cards.ex: Try not to take things so personally; it's just business.
cards.exUz: Narsalarni juda yaqindan qabul qilmaslikka harakat qiling; bu shunchaki biznes.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidni yoki voqealarni shaxsiy his qilish.

cards.ex: I got carried away with the shopping and spent too much money.
cards.exUz: Men xarid qilishga berilib ketdim va juda ko'p pul sarfladim.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ularga berilib, haddan tashqari ko'p narsa qilish.

cards.ex: She's a tough cookie; she can handle anything.
cards.exUz: U bardoshli odam; u har qanday narsani uddalay oladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga bardosh bera oladigan, qat'iyatli odam.

cards.ex: As the manager, he's the one who calls the shots.
cards.exUz: Menejer sifatida u buyruq beradi.

cards.ex: I'm just playing devil's advocate to encourage discussion.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki bahsni rag'batlantirish uchun tanqidchi bo'lyapman.
cards.uzDef: Bahsga sabab bo'lish uchun qarama-qarshi fikrni himoya qilish.

cards.ex: He tends to rub people the wrong way with his sarcastic comments.
cards.exUz: U kinoyali izohlari bilan odamlarning g'ashini keltirishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Birovni g'azablantirish yoki yoqimsiz taassurot qoldirish.

cards.ex: We must have got our wires crossed; I thought the meeting was next week.
cards.exUz: Bizda tushunmovchilik bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak; Men yig'ilish kelasi hafta deb o'yladim.

cards.ex: She doesn't suffer fools gladly, so be prepared to defend your ideas.
cards.exUz: U ahmoqlarni yoqtirmaydi, shuning uchun o'z g'oyangizni himoya qilishga tayyor bo'ling.

cards.ex: I tried to keep a straight face, but his joke was too funny.
cards.exUz: Men jiddiy bo'lishga harakat qildim, lekin uning hazili juda kulgili edi.

cards.ex: He's a bad egg; I wouldn't trust him with anything.
cards.exUz: U yomon odam; men unga hech narsa ishonmasdim.
